_comment: Awin feeds used by Travel Gear World. advertiserId is the Awin advertiser id (file names AWIN_<advertiserId>_<feedId>.csv.gz in the Awin archive). Without feedIds, every file of that retailer is read. Add a retailer only after Awin has approved the programme. First version (22 Oct 2026): the two approved retailers already on Car Gear World that also sell luggage, travel accessories and camping gear. More retailers are added after the travel feed scan (tools/travel-feed-scan.ps1). retailer is the name shown on the site; VEVOR has the NL flag (site.config.js retailerCountries). Case Luggage (Awin 121020, a UK luggage shop already joined) added 31 Oct 2026 after the Hub shadow catalogue (phase 1): about 920 suitcases, travel bags and travel accessories, placed by the VGW rules.
